```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Load libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(xgboost)
library(caret)
```


Load data
```{r}
pga_df <- read.csv("14-22 practice data.csv")
```

Glimpse dataset
```{r}
summary(pga_df)
```

Drop unnecessary columns
```{r}
pga_df <- select(pga_df, -contains("DKP"), -contains("FDP"), -contains("SDP"), -contains("Unnamed"))
```

Glimpse again
```{r}
glimpse(pga_df)
```


```{r}
summary(pga_df)
```


Convert features to appropriate data types and create 'par' column
```{r}
pga_df <- pga_df %>%
  mutate(tournament.id = as.factor(tournament.id)) %>% 
  mutate(tournament.name= as.factor(tournament.name)) %>% 
  mutate(course = as.factor(course)) %>% 
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>% 
  mutate(par = strokes - hole_par)
```

new copy with par and shots gained
```{r}
pga_for_mod <- pga_df %>% 
  select(sg_putt, sg_arg, sg_app, sg_ott, sg_t2g, sg_total, par) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(sg_putt))
```


Split training and test
```{r}
set.seed(111111)
split <- createDataPartition(y = pga_for_mod$par, p=0.8, list = FALSE)
pga_train <- pga_for_mod[split,]
pga_test <- pga_for_mod[-split,]
```



xgbTree
```{r}
set.seed(111111)
xgb_mod <-
  train(
    par ~.,
    data = pga_train,
    method = "xgbTree",
    trControl = trainControl(method = "none", search = "random")
  )
```


```{r}
predicted_par <- predict(xgb_mod, newdata = pga_test)
```


```{r}
# Actual 'par' values
actual_par <- pga_test$par

# Mean Absolute Error
mae <- mean(abs(predicted_par - actual_par))

# Mean Squared Error
mse <- mean((predicted_par - actual_par) ^ 2)

# Root Mean Squared Error
rmse <- sqrt(mse)

print(paste("MAE:", mae))
print(paste("MSE:", mse))
print(paste("RMSE:", rmse))

```


```{r}
cbind(actual_par, predicted_par)
```
